shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.description: We ship from our Jakarta warehouse across Java with local couriers.

sections.title: Where we ship
sections.body: We currently ship within Java only: DKI Jakarta, Banten, West Java, Central Java, DI Yogyakarta and East Java. Outside Java? Chat with us on WhatsApp first.

sections.title: Processing time
sections.body: Ready items are packed and handed to the courier within 1–2 business days after payment. Orders with pre-order items ship together once everything arrives (est. 4–6 weeks).

sections.title: Courier options
sections.body: Instant & same-day (GoSend, GrabExpress) in Greater Jakarta only, for orders paid before the daily cutoff. Express & Regular (JNE, J&T, SiCepat, AnterAja) across Java. Prices & estimates appear at checkout based on your address and parcel weight.

sections.title: Insurance & tracking
sections.body: Shipping insurance is on by default and can be turned off at checkout. Your tracking number is sent on WhatsApp and can be checked on the Track Order page.

payment.title: Payment
payment.description: All payments are digital and paid in full when you place the order.

sections.title: Available methods
sections.body: QRIS (from any e-wallet & mobile banking app), GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay, Virtual Account BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Permata, and credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, JCB).

sections.title: Payment window
sections.body: QRIS 30 minutes, e-wallets & cards 15 minutes, Virtual Account 24 hours. We hold your size for that time. After that, the order expires and the stock is released.

sections.title: Security
sections.body: Payment totals are always recalculated by our system. Card details are never stored by Relevé.

sections.title: Changing method
sections.body: Haven't paid yet? You can switch payment method on the payment page without losing your stock reservation.

sections.title: Are the products original?
sections.body: Yes. Every product is an original Só Dança product that we import. Relevé Dance Supply is an independent store and is not affiliated with Só Dança.

sections.title: How do I choose my size?
sections.body: See the Size Guide and measure your foot length in cm. Between two sizes, or buying pointe shoes? Send us a photo & your measurements on WhatsApp. The consultation is free.

sections.title: What do Ready, Only N left and Pre-order mean?
sections.body: Ready: in our Jakarta warehouse, ships in 1–2 business days. Only N left: low stock. Pre-order: we order it for you, est. arrival 4–6 weeks. Sold out: tap “Notify Me on WhatsApp” and we'll tell you when it's back.

sections.title: Can I exchange sizes or return?
sections.body: Size exchanges and returns are handled case by case on WhatsApp. Contact us within 2 days of receiving your parcel, with the product unworn outdoors and in its complete packaging.

sections.title: Do you ship outside Java?
sections.body: Not through the website yet. Chat with us on WhatsApp and we'll check what's possible.

sections.title: Do I need an account?
sections.body: No. Just enter your name, WhatsApp number and address at checkout. Check your order on Track Order with your order number and the last 4 digits of your WhatsApp number.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms for shopping at Relevé Dance Supply.

sections.title: About the store
sections.body: Relevé Dance Supply is an independent reseller of Só Dança products and is not affiliated with Só Dança. The Só Dança name and brand belong to their owner.

sections.title: Prices & payment
sections.body: Prices are in Rupiah and include import costs. Orders are processed once full digital payment is received within the stated time.

sections.title: Stock & pre-orders
sections.body: Stock is shown per variant and held during the payment window. Pre-order estimates are 4–6 weeks and may change; we'll let you know on WhatsApp if they do.

sections.title: Shipping
sections.body: We ship within Java only, from Jakarta. Shipping risk is covered by insurance when enabled.

sections.title: Size exchanges & returns
sections.body: Handled case by case on WhatsApp. Products must be unworn outdoors, clean and in complete packaging.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we use your personal data, in line with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: The name, WhatsApp number, email (optional) and shipping address you enter at checkout, plus your WhatsApp number when you ask for a stock alert.

sections.title: What we use it for
sections.body: Only to process & ship your order, and to send order updates and stock alerts on WhatsApp when you agree to it. We never sell your personal data.

sections.title: Payments
sections.body: Payments are processed by our payment provider. Card details are never stored by Relevé.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can ask for a copy, correction or deletion of your data, and stop receiving messages at any time, by contacting us on WhatsApp.

about.title: About Relevé
about.description: An independent dance store in Jakarta for Só Dança shoes & dancewear.

sections.title: Who we are
sections.body: Relevé Dance Supply is an independent store in Jakarta selling original Só Dança products (imported). We are not affiliated with Só Dança.

sections.title: How we work
sections.body: Honest stock per size, size consultations on WhatsApp, digital payments (QRIS, e-wallets, Virtual Account, cards), and shipping from Jakarta across Java.

sections.title: For studios
sections.body: Need several pairs for your students? Chat with us on WhatsApp and we'll help put the order together.
